messages.subject: display mode = showcase for deployApp?
parts:
Just wondering if there is an equivalent to 
runApps( , display.mode = "showcase") for deployApp.

Or any other way to show the .R files next to the display.

Thanks!

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] display mode = showcase for deployApp?
parts: You can put a DESCRIPTION file in your app directory that specifies the app should be shown in Showcase mode; see http://shiny.rstudio.com/articles/display-modes.html, section "Writing for Showcase mode". When you deploy to shinyapps, the DESCRIPTION file will be deployed with the app.
